publicPrototypeClaims.text: Since 2008, Rofo has been working to make commercial real estate easier for smaller businesses.
Smaller searches were often poorly served by a process built around larger commissions and longer commitments.
Rofo began by helping smaller businesses reach more commercial-space information and opportunities.
The location question had become part of the work: how a company operates, who it needs to reach and what kind of place supports it.
Rofo was started by commercial real estate professionals who believed technology could make the process work better for smaller businesses.
By 2010, Inc. was writing about Rofo's approach to choosing a location—not just finding available space, but considering the business, its people and the surrounding area.
Rofo helps businesses understand districts, compare locations and find spaces that fit.
